<stasis/>Shattering enemies or <stasis/>Crystals creates an additional damage instance, dealing up to <pve 25 /> <pvp [9] /> damage in a <pve 10 /> <pvp [8] /> meter radius. Falls off to <pve 17 /> <pvp [4] /> Damage at the edge of the radius.

This translates to a maximum of a <pve 12.5% /> <pvp [4.5%] /> total <stasis/>Shatter Damage Increase.
